decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The existing outbuilding for use as an art studio, by way of its position, design and appearance, has due regard for the sites' characteristics and the dynamics of the surrounding built environment, and is not detrimental to the amenity of the adjoining properties or the immediate locality.  The development is therefore in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) H.4.1 (Housing standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant no undue adverse effects result.

Condition : 2 - The use of the outbuilding hereby permitted for facilitation as a religious art studio shall be personal to Miss C. Crook and shall not be utilised by more than 5 people at any one time.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for religious art purposes shall not be carried on outside the hours of 0800-2100 Monday to Sunday.
description: Retention of a detached building to rear of premises for use as a studio ancillary to existing dwellinghouse.
